name: Sanjou Minori
source:
Occupation: Volunteer Department
Role: Advant-Garde

Sanjou's magical girl form. Essential support attacker of the team. She is very sensitive of her appearance.

Her magical abilities are "Sorawotobu" (空を飛ぶ) and "Beam" (ビーム).
